name: Yellow Stem Borer
symptoms: Dead hearts: Drying of central growing tiller shoots during vegetative stage
White ears / Whiteheads: Completely chaffy, bleached white panicles standing upright at heading stage
Tiny entry bore-holes visible at the base of the rice culm
causes: Moth laying mass eggs near leaf tips covered in buff-colored anal hairs; larvae boring directly inside stem

favorableConditions.weatherFactor: Cloudy, warm humid conditions in late Kharif season

prevention: Clip the leaf tips of rice seedlings before transplanting to remove egg masses
Set up light traps and pheromone traps (5 traps/acre) to track moth emergence
Destroy rice stubbles immediately after harvest through deep tilling
management: Release egg parasitoid Trichogramma japonicum @ 40,000/acre at weekly intervals
Apply recommended granular or liquid bio-insecticides when dead heart percentage exceeds ETL (5-10%)
Coordinate pest monitoring with the local Agricultural Extension Officer
source: ICAR - Indian Institute of Rice Research (IIRR)

name: Chilli Thrips
symptoms: Upward curling of leaf margins ('boat-shaped' leaves)
Silvering and bronzing on the lower surface of leaves
Petiole elongation, brittle crinkly leaves, and stunted plant buds ('Murda' complex)
causes: Microscopic slender fringed-winged insects rasping foliage cells and sucking cell sap

favorableConditions.weatherFactor: Dry hot periods with absence of heavy rain washes

prevention: Install blue sticky traps (15-20 traps/acre) specifically attractive to thrips
Intercrop with maize, cowpea, or coriander to encourage natural predators like anthocorid bugs
Sprinkler irrigation washings help dislodge thrips populations
management: Foliar spray of 5% Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE) or entomopathogenic fungus Lecanicillium lecanii @ 5g/liter
Spray approved eco-friendly insecticides strictly if leaf damage crosses ETL (1-2 thrips per leaf)
Rotate chemical modes of action to prevent rapid insecticide resistance
